slides.title: 15 things TB-500 supposedly heals
slides.text: Let's check what the research says 👉

slides.kicker: The claim: works on the whole body
slides.title: TB-500
slides.text: Data is mostly animals and cell cultures. A 2024 study found TB-500 itself didn't speed healing. No clinical trials in people.

slides.kicker: The claim: fast healing at the injury site
slides.title: BPC-157
slides.text: A 2025 review: 3 small human studies, under 30 people in total, no control groups.
'Research only' means 'not a drug', not 'it works'.

caption:
15 things TB-500 supposedly heals? 🧬 We checked what holds up in human research. Spoiler: almost nothing.
